grownetLabApp.title: GrowNet Lab App
grownetLabApp.summary: The desktop lab application for running and exploring GrowNet builds on Windows. This release line is intended to be updated by the .NET 10 WPF installer pipeline.

grownetSourceSnapshot.title: GrowNet source snapshot
grownetSourceSnapshot.summary: A clean, versioned archive of the current GrowNet codebase, published as a repository snapshot rather than an installer build.
